description: Task definitions of the first imitation pass: the tasks whose ids occur in the rows of that pass. The rows (trajectories) are not released.
comparison: instruction (or prompt when a record has no instruction field) and edit_params compared as parsed JSON values; input_ifc names the source model
note: a task id is built from the element family, the operation, the category, the building and a running number, so the two generator versions reuse ids for different tasks on the same source model
